name: "Lighthouse" Movable Action Model
description: Upon use, increases DEF of all allies by 25% in the next battle.
story:
"Lighthouse" is Astropolis's most iconic homegrown IP, and the merchandise has never stopped flying off the shelves. Nobody knows who started this quirky tradition, but some people actually believe that this movable action model has the power to "bless your home and keep it safe," so they buy one and enshrine it right by their front door.

"Please, 'Lighthouse,' I'm begging you! Bless me so I can pass my exams and land a job at the Life Sciences Institute!"
"Isn't he supposed to bless your home? Why are you asking him for exam luck? You really think that's gonna work?"
"Doesn't matter. I've already prayed to every single Aeon out there. Might as well throw him in too."
